normalization:
Read-only duplicate/candidate analysis consuming inventory worker records.
Run: python3 candidates.py REQUIREMENTS_JSON OUTPUT_DIR
Normative body normalization: Unicode NFC, whitespace runs -> ASCII space, strip.
No punctuation/case/identifier removal; scenarios excluded. Lexical score is Jaccard
on lowercase ASCII alphanumeric identifier tokens >=3 chars after fixed stopwords.
Only cross-capability lexical pairs scored. Scores are candidates, never findings.
